name: useGeminiLive
summary: Real-time bidirectional streaming audio, text, and hardware tool execution with Gemini 3.8 Multimodal Live API.
plain: Streams live bidirectional voice and text with Gemini in the cloud over WebSockets, executing real-time hardware diagnostics and actions with low-latency audio duplexing.
description: Establishes a persistent full-duplex WebSocket connection to the Gemini Multimodal Live API. Streams base64-encoded PCM audio chunks from device microphones, receives low-latency synthesized speech responses, exposes live extended thinking thought streams, and intercepts model tool calls to execute device hardware actuators and sensors with zero round-trip delay.

params.name: config
params.desc: Configuration options for model name, voice profile ('Aoede', 'Puck', etc.), system instruction, thinking budget, and hardware tool binding.

returns.name: isConnected
returns.desc: Whether the WebSocket session to Gemini Live is active and ready.

returns.name: isStreaming
returns.desc: Whether the model is actively streaming an audio or text response.

returns.name: isSpeaking
returns.desc: Whether synthesized speech audio is currently playing.

returns.name: isListening
returns.desc: Whether the client is streaming microphone audio chunks to the server.

returns.name: currentThinking
returns.desc: Latest reasoning thoughts emitted by the model during extended thinking.

returns.name: activeToolCalls
returns.desc: Real-time hardware tool invocations executed during the session.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if connection or streaming protocol encountered a failure.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Data provenance: 'hardware' when connected with valid key, or 'unavailable'.

returns.name: connect
returns.desc: Establishes the bidirectional WebSocket session to the Gemini Live endpoint.

returns.name: disconnect
returns.desc: Closes the active live streaming session.

returns.name: sendText
returns.desc: Sends a text prompt through the live duplex session.

returns.name: sendAudioChunk
returns.desc: Streams a base64 PCM audio chunk from the microphone array.

returns.name: interrupt
returns.desc: Signals the model to interrupt speech immediately.

returns.name: clearTranscript
returns.desc: Clears the transcript and active tool calls.

actions.name: connect(customApiKey)
actions.desc: Opens the duplex WebSocket connection to Gemini Live.

actions.name: sendText(text)
actions.desc: Sends a text message to the live session.

actions.name: sendAudioChunk(pcmBase64)
actions.desc: Sends a PCM audio packet to the live session.

actions.name: clearTranscript()
actions.desc: Clears conversation history and active tool calls.

agentNote: Supports bidirectional audio duplex streaming and real-time hardware tool calling over WebSockets.
